meta.source: Alibio brand kit (sea palette) and the Alibio homepage build, 2026-11-24

tokens.name: warm-ivory
tokens.usage: Page ground. Brand kit colour Warm Ivory. Text on it: charcoal (14.2:1) or ink-muted (5.5:1).

tokens.name: ivory-shade
tokens.usage: Surface one step off the ground: the stay panel, menu cards. Charcoal on it 12.7:1, ink-muted 4.9:1.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Ink for all reading text, hairlines (at 14%) and interface glyphs. Brand kit colour Charcoal.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, condo facts, dates and the quiet half of a heading. 5.5:1 on warm-ivory; never for body copy.

tokens.name: blue-green
tokens.usage: The one action colour: primary buttons, links, focus ring. Its ivory label reads 5.1:1. Brand kit colour Blue Green.

tokens.name: navy-blue
tokens.usage: The brand band: the closing section and other full-width brand moments. Ivory text on it 10.9:1. Brand kit colour Navy Blue.

tokens.name: avocado
tokens.usage: Reserve accent from the brand kit, for print and social only. Not used in the web interface; ivory on it 5.1:1.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines that close list rows and sit under the nav. Charcoal at 14%.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Airbnb mark to 'Book on Airbnb'.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Label to its list.

tokens.name: space-4

tokens.usage: Grid gutter; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6

tokens.name: space-10

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Photographs, condo cards and panels: square corners everywhere on the site.
